info.title: Backend-SWE API
info.description: Source-derived current Backend-SWE contract, reviewed 2026-11-21 at draft/version-1 commit 5585ddd. Includes authentication/email/Google, profiles/addresses, search/filter/catalog/media/wishlist, behavior tracking, Inventory availability, Cart, atomic Checkout, Order history/cancellation, owned Voucher wallet, verified product reviews/ratings with optional images, and product recommendations. Inventory reservation/completion internals, admin granting/stock supply, payment, shipping-to-completed/received/failed and Voucher cancellation-quota policy do not expose new HTTP routes. Root bearer security is overridden for public operations. Authorities are current database grants, not OAuth scopes. Exact VND JSON integers may exceed JavaScript safe precision. Examples are synthetic. No runtime Swagger access or security policy is changed.

servers.description: Same backend origin; local default port 8080, Docker host port may differ.

post.summary: Initiate pending email registration
post.description: Validate email/password, create pending registration, challenge and encrypted mail outbox only. No user, username/official-email reservation, session or tokens. Initial password is not stored. Confirm using the initiating credential, code and newly supplied authoritative password. Independent same-email attempts may coexist. Public route ignores unrelated bearer headers.

Cache-Control.description: Sensitive response must not be cached.

post.summary: Sign in with username or current email
post.description: Sign in with normalized email or legacy username and exact password. No password trimming. Eligible ACTIVE user and current grants required. Google-only users without a local password fail generically. Creates an independent seven-day application session. Public credential route ignores unrelated bearer headers.

Authorization.description: Access JWT as Bearer <token>. Copy the token into subsequent Authorization request headers. Example is a placeholder, not a live credential.

Cache-Control.description: Do not cache token responses.

post.summary: Rotate a refresh token
post.description: Validate the exact body secret, consume it and issue a replacement for the same session and unchanged seven-day deadline. An attached bearer header is ignored. Reusing a consumed secret while its session is active revokes that entire session before returning 401; previously issued access/replacement refresh tokens then fail. Other sessions survive. Concurrent requests with the same secret can yield one success followed by reuse revocation. A retry after a lost committed response has the same strict reuse behavior; there is no grace window.

200.description: Refresh rotated; replace the stored refresh token.

Authorization.description: Access JWT as Bearer <token>. Copy the token into subsequent Authorization request headers. Example is a placeholder, not a live credential.

Cache-Control.description: Do not cache token responses.

post.summary: Revoke one session using its refresh token
post.description: No valid access token is required; an attached bearer header is ignored. A recognized current or consumed refresh secret revokes its owning session. Repeating logout with a recognized revoked-session secret succeeds until absolute session expiry. Unknown or absolutely expired secrets return 401, independently of cleanup. Other sessions are unaffected.

204.description: Session revoked, or already revoked but not absolutely expired. No body.

put.summary: Change password and revoke all sessions
put.description: Requires a valid current bearer/session and the exact current password. The replacement must differ and satisfy the registration policy. Atomically change the BCrypt hash and revoke every session, including the authenticating session. Return no replacement tokens. Subsequent requests using old access/refresh credentials fail; already-authenticated in-flight work is not cancelled.

204.description: Password changed and all sessions revoked. No body or token pair.

get.description: Uses the immutable authenticated user ID, never a client-selected owner. Requires the exact MANAGE_USER_PROFILE authority from current database grants.

Cache-Control.description: Sensitive response must not be cached.

put.description: Selective PUT: omitted fields preserve. Null displayName/phone/gender/dateOfBirth preserves; supplied username cannot be null. profileImageId null clears. Any supplied email (even null/blank) fails 400 EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED; use email verification. Reject protected/unknown properties. Requires MANAGE_USER_PROFILE. Changing username changes its login identifier, never the immutable account ID. Official email is changed only through proof confirmation.

Cache-Control.description: Sensitive response must not be cached.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Resource BIGINT identifier. A syntactically valid absent ID returns 404.

get.description: Requires valid bearer authentication only; no feature-specific permission or role restriction. Does not expose email, phone, addresses, password, status or authority data.

Cache-Control.description: Sensitive response must not be cached.

get.description: Owner is the immutable authenticated user. Returns a plain array, default address first then id descending; no pagination parameters. Empty address book returns []. Maximum 20 addresses.

post.summary: Add an address
post.description: At most 20 addresses per user; exceeding the limit returns 400. The first address becomes default even when isDefault is omitted/null/false. For later addresses, true promotes the new address and clears the previous default; omitted/null/false creates a non-default address. Required text is trimmed; recipientPhone must match 0 followed by nine ASCII digits. Ownership comes from authentication.

Location.description: Relative URL of the created address.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Resource BIGINT identifier. A syntactically valid absent ID returns 404.

get.description: Both MANAGE_ADDRESS and ownership are required. A missing address and an address owned by another user both return 404.

put.summary: Replace address details and optionally promote default
put.description: Resubmit all three required text fields. Omitted/null isDefault preserves the existing flag; true promotes this address and clears any previous default. Explicit false on the current default is invalid (400); select another default or delete instead. Foreign/missing IDs return 404 for an authorized caller. The operation is atomic.

delete.description: Delete the owned address. If it was default, promote the remaining address with the greatest ID; deleting the final address leaves an empty book. Foreign/missing IDs return 404 for an authorized caller. Requires MANAGE_ADDRESS.

post.summary: Confirm registration and create verified account
post.description: Require current initiating credential, current challenge/code and authoritative password. Atomically consume proof and create verified ACTIVE/default USER account, derived username, session and refresh credential. Replay fails; existing-email conflict never authenticates/links that account. Legacy accounts retain access.

Cache-Control.description: Sensitive response must not be cached.

Authorization.description: Application access JWT. Submit as Authorization: Bearer <token> on protected requests.

post.summary: Replace pending registration proof immediately
post.description: No cooldown or send quota. Atomically supersede current challenge/outbox and rotate initiating credential/code for another ten minutes. Old credential/code fails. Lost replacement credential requires independent registration; public ID/email alone cannot recover it.

Cache-Control.description: Sensitive response must not be cached.

post.summary: Create or immediately replace an owned email challenge
post.description: REGISTRATION verifies only historical user current email, never new signup. Already verified returns 409. EMAIL_CHANGE destination must differ and be available. Same-purpose send supersedes only this owner previous challenge; no request quota/cooldown. Official email remains until valid confirmation.

Cache-Control.description: Sensitive response must not be cached.

get.description: No code is returned; missing/foreign challenge returns identical 404.

Cache-Control.description: Sensitive response must not be cached.

post.summary: Verify historical email or replace official email
post.description: EMAIL_CHANGE requires current code plus fresh owner/original-active-session EMAIL_CHANGE proof. Proof expires five minutes after authentication; reacquire if needed while ten-minute code is valid. Atomically replace verified official email, consume proof/challenge, preserve username and Google metadata. Wrong codes leave current challenge valid.

Cache-Control.description: Sensitive response must not be cached.

post.summary: Issue fresh account ownership proof
post.description: Validate current local password and original active session. Return single-use operation-bound proof valid five minutes from actual authentication. No failure quota/lockout. No local password or wrong password returns generic 401. Newly added Google identity cannot establish this account proof.

Cache-Control.description: Sensitive response must not be cached.

post.summary: Set first local password for a Google-only account
post.description: Requires fresh INITIAL_PASSWORD proof of the already linked Google identity and original active bearer session. Atomically create BCrypt password, consume proof and revoke all sessions including current. Return no replacement tokens; sign in again. Already set returns 409; failed operation preserves credential/session state. Existing password changes use PUT /api/auth/password.

Cache-Control.description: Sensitive response must not be cached.

get.description: Only connected status and nullable linkedAt; no provider subject/email disclosure.

Cache-Control.description: Sensitive response must not be cached.

post.summary: Start public Google sign-in
post.description: Public LOGIN ignores unrelated bearer credentials. Retain frontend PKCE verifier. Serialize every initiation across LOGIN/LINK/REAUTH and coordinated tabs until the complete prior response and cookie processing settles. One active server generation; new initiation supersedes old attempt. Generation checks cannot order browser Set-Cookie responses. If overlapping responses strand correlation, wait for all to settle, discard flow data and restart serially. Same schemeful site in production; credentialed exact-origin CORS required. Cookie is not application authentication.

Cache-Control.description: Sensitive response must not be cached.

Set-Cookie.description: google_handshake correlation cookie, Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; Max-Age=300. Initiation alone sets it. Callbacks never modify/delete it. Not application authentication.

post.summary: Start explicit Google linking
post.description: Require fresh CONNECT_GOOGLE account proof and original active bearer session; separate provider proof identifies the identity to add. Retain frontend PKCE verifier. Serialize every initiation across LOGIN/LINK/REAUTH and coordinated tabs until the complete prior response and cookie processing settles. One active server generation; new initiation supersedes old attempt. Generation checks cannot order browser Set-Cookie responses. If overlapping responses strand correlation, wait for all to settle, discard flow data and restart serially. Same schemeful site in production; credentialed exact-origin CORS required. Cookie is not application authentication.

Cache-Control.description: Sensitive response must not be cached.

Set-Cookie.description: google_handshake correlation cookie, Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; Max-Age=300. Initiation alone sets it. Callbacks never modify/delete it. Not application authentication.

post.summary: Start fresh already-linked Google authentication
post.description: Only already linked Google identity may issue account proof. For EMAIL_CHANGE/CONNECT_GOOGLE use password instead when one exists. INITIAL_PASSWORD requires absent local password. Provider max_age=0 and auth_time enforce freshness. Retain frontend PKCE verifier. Serialize every initiation across LOGIN/LINK/REAUTH and coordinated tabs until the complete prior response and cookie processing settles. One active server generation; new initiation supersedes old attempt. Generation checks cannot order browser Set-Cookie responses. If overlapping responses strand correlation, wait for all to settle, discard flow data and restart serially. Same schemeful site in production; credentialed exact-origin CORS required. Cookie is not application authentication.

Cache-Control.description: Sensitive response must not be cached.

Set-Cookie.description: google_handshake correlation cookie, Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; Max-Age=300. Initiation alone sets it. Callbacks never modify/delete it. Not application authentication.

post.summary: Redeem single-use application handoff
post.description: Application code is not the Google authorization code. It expires after 60 seconds and requires its S256 verifier. LOGIN is public and ignores unrelated invalid bearer; atomically resolves/creates account and session. New Google account requires verified usable email, derived username, ACTIVE/default role and null local password. Matching existing official email returns 409 ACCOUNT_CONNECTION_REQUIRED, never auto-links. Returning issuer/subject preserves managed profile/email. LINK/REAUTH require explicit original active bearer session and current profile permission; cookies never suffice. LINK consumes fresh CONNECT_GOOGLE proof, handoff and association atomically; same-link idempotent with fresh proofs, no replacement/reassignment/partial association. REAUTH proves already-linked identity and issues operation-bound proof for five minutes from provider auth_time. No request throttling; malformed or failed proof remains 400/401.

200.description: LOGIN: TokenResponse plus Authorization header. LINK: GoogleConnectionResponse, no tokens. REAUTH: RecentAuthProofResponse, no tokens.

Cache-Control.description: Sensitive response must not be cached.

Authorization.description: Application access JWT. Submit as Authorization: Bearer <token> on protected requests. Present only for LOGIN.

post.x-security-condition: Anonymous only for LOGIN; original bearer session plus MANAGE_USER_PROFILE required for LINK/REAUTH.

get.description: Framework validates state, nonce, signature, issuer, audience, expiry and required auth_time. Success creates only a 60-second application handoff and redirects to configured frontend success URI with ?code=<application-code>. Failure redirects to configured failure URI with safe ?error= category. Never sets/deletes/refreshes correlation cookie, even on failure. Superseded/replayed/missing correlation never issues credentials or mutates newer attempt; safely restart after outstanding initiations settle.

get.summary: Search and filter published electronics products

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Singleton; canonical unsigned integer syntax, no leading zeros except 0; duplicate/empty invalid.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Singleton; same canonical syntax; duplicate/empty invalid.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Singleton. At most 16 normalized tokens. Blank means omitted. Literal null is ordinary text. Token AND across shared Product fields and a single eligible variant. Preserve technical punctuation/digits; no wildcard syntax. Apply design-resolutions D1-D4. Whitespace-only omitted; nonblank zero tokens400. Raw16-token limit before normalized dedup; original order/repetitions retained for phrase boost. Preserve D2 connectors/decimals; typed numeric equivalence never rewrites textual model IDs.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Singleton. Includes self and all descendants. Required with specFilters. Unknown valid UUID gives no matches after global filter syntax/approval validation.

parameters.name: brandId
parameters.description: Repeat parameter for OR selection; no CSV. Duplicates collapse; empty invalid.

parameters.name: minPrice
parameters.description: Singleton inclusive VND bound, nonnegative whole amount, at most 30 digits; minPrice <= maxPrice. Empty/fraction/exponent invalid.

parameters.name: maxPrice
parameters.description: Singleton inclusive VND bound, nonnegative whole amount, at most 30 digits; minPrice <= maxPrice. Empty/fraction/exponent invalid.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Singleton. Default relevance with nonblank q, UUID ascending otherwise. relevance without q invalid. Price uses representative; name normalized COLLATE C. Final UUID ASC in either direction. D7 null orphan prices sort LAST in both price directions. Relevance exact subtiers are defined by analysis-remediation.md R3/RK01-RK10;whole-query identifier equality is not a scattered-token identifier-count boost.

parameters.name: specFilters
parameters.description: Singleton URL-encoded JSON. Groups AND, alternatives within a group OR. All variant keyword/price/spec predicates bind the same variant. Only registry-approved definitions activate. No conversion; unknown fields/nulls unsupported. Strict duplicate JSON-member rejection before DTO binding, even equal values. Known-category unsupported key/combination400; supported no-match200.

200.description: Published products with deterministic representative variant, exact display price and observed sellable availability. Null representative/price/availability are paired for retained orphan listings. Stock does not filter search results.

X-Catalog-Search-Mode.description: Required with nonblank q: fuzzy-enabled normally, exact-only only for explicit operator-disabled diagnostic mode. Not required without keyword.

400.description: Invalid/unknown/duplicate parameters, unsupported filter/type/unit/operator, missing categoryId or incompatible definitions.

401.description: Existing authentication handling for explicitly supplied invalid bearer credentials; anonymous GET remains public.

500.description: Unexpected server/infrastructure failure; never represented as an empty successful search.

503.description: Required search capability lost after startup for nonblank q in either configured mode; no silent exact-only or successful empty fallback. Missing startup capability blocks rollout.

get.description: Public reads hide missing/DRAFT/ARCHIVED products with 404. Signed image URLs at most five minutes; reread detail to refresh. Includes variants and ordered image gallery. Errors use plain RFC 9457 ProblemDetail; do not require legacy timestamp/message/path/fieldErrors extensions.

post.summary: Attach an owned completed upload to a product
post.description: Current ROLE_ADMIN and ownership of COMPLETED source required. Complete upload first. Validate actual image (up to 10485760 bytes); no remote URL upload. Gallery max ten, one primary, distinct order and no duplicate content. Same source/metadata replay returns 200; incompatible replay 409. Attachment creates a distinct durable product image, not a signed URL response. A product may be unpublished while an administrator manages its gallery. Errors use plain RFC 9457 ProblemDetail; do not require legacy timestamp/message/path/fieldErrors extensions.

Cache-Control.description: Sensitive response must not be cached.
Sensitive response must not be cached.

post.summary: Cancel PENDING or CONFIRMED order idempotently
post.description: Optional body/reason. PENDING and CONFIRMED may cancel; an already-CANCELLED order returns204 without repeating Inventory work. SHIPPING/COMPLETED/FAILED409. On a first cancellation, current clock before placement409; repeated CANCELLED success does not sample Clock. Releases managed reserved quantity only once; legacy orders do not mutate Inventory. Original successful receipt is unchanged. Voucher cancellation-quota policy deferred; no new restoration/reissue action. No query.

parameters.description: Canonical positive Long.

post.summary: Place an order or replay its original successful receipt
post.description: Address-only request/fingerprint; selected grant captured from locked Cart, never request input. Revalidate publication/full stock, skip unavailable rows, and calculate base from included lines. No eligible rows422 with skippedItems. Invalid captured Voucher409 VOUCHER_NOT_APPLICABLE plus safe reason, with no cleanup or undiscounted fallback. Voucher locks precede one authoritative timestamp/expiry validation. Atomically persist order/items, reserved-only Inventory, chosen-grant consumption/redemption/quota, included-row removal, selection clear and immutable receipt; failures roll back all and leave key reusable. Remaining/skipped rows and other grants survive. Receipt-first lookup and acquired/busy-fence committed rechecks return original201; only genuinely uncommitted processing yields409 CHECKOUT_IN_PROGRESS. Matching address command required, even if address was later deleted. Replay does not read/reprice/mutate current Cart/Voucher/Inventory/order. New receipts have Voucher fields; old receipts retain exact legacy shape. MANAGE_CHECKOUT alone suffices. No query. Missing body400; unsupported nonempty media415.

Location.description: Original order URL, including successful replays.

404.description: Missing or foreign resource; no ownership disclosure.

409.description: CHECKOUT_IN_PROGRESS for no visible committed receipt while processing; CHECKOUT_KEY_CONFLICT for different address; CHECKOUT_CONFLICT for locking/integrity, or VOUCHER_NOT_APPLICABLE with safe reason. No failed idempotency receipt or partial mutation.

422.description: NO_ELIGIBLE_CHECKOUT_ITEMS with exact skippedItems, or CHECKOUT_AMOUNT_LIMIT when exact aggregate exceeds PostgreSQL NUMERIC supported integer digits (131072). Key remains reusable and no partial mutation.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Exactly one header, exact case-sensitive bytes; no trimming/comma combination. Scoped to authenticated customer and CHECKOUT.

get.summary: List reviews of a published product
get.description: Anonymous access for PUBLISHED products only. Reject unknown/repeated query parameters. Empty out-of-range pages are valid. Stable sort uses id DESC for ties. Inactive authors remain visible as Former customer with null avatar. Reviews are not limited by the page used for the rating summary. Filters combine by AND; totals are filtered and every sort appends ID descending. Unknown/repeated parameters are rejected. Rating summary remains product-wide.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Canonical unsigned decimal, zero-based.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Canonical unsigned decimal.

parameters.description: Review ID descending breaks every tie.

parameters.name: rating

bearerAuth.description: HS256 JWT via Authorization: Bearer <token>. Access lifetime <=900 seconds, capped by a fixed seven-day session deadline; expiry equality is rejected. sub is immutable user ID; sid identifies its session. User must currently be ACTIVE, session must exist/belong to user/be unrevoked/unexpired; authorities are read from the database, not trusted token role/scope claims. Cookie/query/form access tokens are not accepted.

googleHandshake.name: google_handshake
googleHandshake.description: Five-minute browser correlation only; never authorizes application APIs. Initiation sets it, callback never writes/deletes it; server consumption rejects replay even while cookie survives.

identifier.description: Trim surrounding whitespace. If it contains @, look up current email only; otherwise username only. Case-insensitive database comparison; no fallback between types.

password.description: Exact password, without trimming or normalization. Values exceeding 72 UTF-8 bytes fail authentication/current-password verification; the 8-code-point registration minimum is not reapplied here.

refreshToken.description: Exact opaque secret; do not trim. Issued tokens contain 43 unpadded Base64URL characters from 32 random bytes. Input accepts any nonempty string up to 1024 Unicode code points; unknown values receive 401.

400.description: Malformed/binding/field/business validation failure. Examples: missing required value, prohibited field, blank normalized text, invalid default transition, address capacity, incorrect current password or unchanged replacement password.

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired bearer authentication on protected operations, or rejected body credentials on credential operations. Also non-ACTIVE account, missing/foreign/revoked/expired session or refresh reuse. Messages do not identify a missing account versus a wrong password.

403.description: Authenticated caller lacks the exact required permission. Requests are rejected before business mutation. Cross-origin requests from an unapproved origin may instead be rejected by the CORS filter with a framework response.

404.description: Requested resource does not exist. Foreign addresses are indistinguishable from missing addresses for an otherwise authorized caller.

409.description: Uniqueness, concurrent mutation, identity association or media lifecycle conflict. No partial domain mutation; response loss alone is not rollback evidence.

500.description: Unexpected safe server error. Do not infer rollback of external storage/SMTP side effects from an HTTP failure.

503.description: Storage/signing, identity persistence or required enabled-feature services unavailable. No provider details or secrets disclosed.

BearerUnauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or expired bearer authentication on protected operations, or rejected body credentials on credential operations. Also non-ACTIVE account, missing/foreign/revoked/expired session or refresh reuse. Messages do not identify a missing account versus a wrong password.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Set by the bearer filter-chain entry point. Body-credential 401 responses do not necessarily include this header.

422.description: Empty/corrupt/undecodable image or declared/stored/decoded content type mismatch.
